title: tsw/rows/v1
description: Rows handed to tsdb-writer on the internal subject tsw.v1.<table> (JetStream stream TSW, 10 min; docs/PLAN.md §6). Owned by uspace-authority (WP-9). Internal to this system: NATS never crosses a system, and the message carries no 04 §2 envelope (it is a storage hand-over, not an event). Producers publish with internal/store/ts.Writer (or, for rid_observations, rid-ingest's JetRows, WP-7) and set Nats-Msg-Id so a retried publish is stored once within the stream's duplicate window; tsdb-writer's dedupe key covers redelivery beyond it. At most 1 MiB (the stream's maximum message size). tsdb-writer refuses a message whose table is not the subject's, which has no rows, or whose row lacks a NOT NULL column, has a value of the wrong kind or a member the table does not have; a refused message is recorded in writer_gaps as malformed, never dropped silently.

table.description: The hypertable; equal to the <table> token of the subject.

rows.description: Rows of the table. Each member is a column of the table (migrations/timeseries), by its column name: timestamptz as an RFC 3339 string, bytea as standard base64, integers and floats as JSON numbers, booleans as JSON booleans; a nullable column may be null or absent.
